author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Granola step by step in this beginner tutorial. Get started with Granola for free: https://go.granola.ai/kevin
Granola automatically transcribes your meetings, generates AI-powered summaries, action items, and follow-up emails. It works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and even in-person meetings using your phone or Apple Watch.

In this tutorial, you'll learn how to:
- Install Granola
- Connect your calendar
- Join meetings without a meeting bot 
- Take notes alongside AI transcription 
- Generate AI meeting summaries 
- Search across all of your meeting notes 
- Ask AI questions about past conversations 
- Capture ad hoc meetings on your computer, phone, and Apple Watch
